scope: Explicit ERC20 precise approve/reset, pre-dispatch journal and read-only transaction/receipt recovery. Actual deposit submission remains unavailable.

authorization.spender: Fixed documented vault for the selected chain; displayed separately from the token target.
authorization.policy: Zero insufficient allowance: exact requested units. Nonzero insufficient allowance: approve zero first. No unlimited approval, no native-asset approval.
authorization.confirmation: Each step has a fresh explicit prepare, immutable review and confirmation. Full wallet/allowance/balance/Gas/nonce estimate repeated before send; changed parameters require a new review. Expiry and identity checked again after durable write.
authorization.signer: Current Reown EOA or existing Privy embedded wallet; no new wallet, fallback signer, implicit chain switch, automatic next step or retries.
authorization.funding_boundary: Approval costs native gas and is not a deposit. Deposit remains blocked on unknown user/platform caps and incomplete credit recovery.

recovery.schema: Version 1; strict bounded lexical JSON, canonical integer strings, immutable exact unsigned terms, wallet/chain/nonce, block/hash, timestamp and optional reported hash. No signature, secret or executable queue.
recovery.write: Serialize mutations; flushed temporary file followed by same-directory rename before dispatch. At most one unresolved record per wallet across supported chains. Storage/corruption failures block new sends and preserve the record.
recovery.hash_failure: Returned hashes retained in memory even if locating/reading/writing storage fails. Reload validates original unsigned terms and merges retained hash before further writes. A crash before a failed hash write is recovered through saved unsigned terms and manual hash.
recovery.dispatch_outcomes: Only known-not-sent or structured rejection removes pre-send record without a receipt. Unknown result stays unresolved. Returned hashes journaled under original wallet even after stop/logout/disposal.
recovery.transaction_binding: Candidate hash, chain, from and nonce must match saved scope. Economic intent is exact to/input/value; matching speedup hashes can be checked, pending replacements do not overwrite original hash.
recovery.receipt_binding: Match transaction hash/from/to/block/hash, status 0/1, gas usage, recent head and canonical receipt block. At least 2 observed confirmations required to resolve, including reverted transactions; this is an observation policy, not a finality guarantee.
recovery.replacement: Same-wallet/chain/nonce different-intent transaction remains pending until canonical 2-confirmation receipt. Resolves as replaced, never as approval success. Does not overwrite stored original hash.
recovery.fees: Exact BigInt gasUsed times effectiveGasPrice, legacy gasPrice fallback or unknown. Extra network fees may be separate.
recovery.ui: Explicit read-only check; optional original/speedup/cancellation hash, retained after scroll/failure/stop; copyable terms; current-wallet isolation; no resend or delete action. Re-read current allowance after any terminal result.
limitations: No automatic nonce scan, hash discovery, retry, queue continuation or deposit submission.
Uninstall/data clearing loses local recovery; native filesystem, power loss and process death have not been verified.
No receipt proves actual allowance change or platform credit. Future reorgs remain possible after observed confirmations.

remaining: Actual deposit plus user/platform caps, on-chain receipt and platform credit recovery.
Withdrawal and Spot/Futures or main/subaccount transfer workflows.
Safe explicit chain switching/older-session reauthorization, final fees and native Max.
Native wallets, public RPC behavior, storage recovery, layouts and iOS build remain unverified.
